bio: Principal MLOps Architect & Co-founder @KubeTensorID. Fractional GPU scheduling, cold-start snapshotting & Kubernetes inference orchestration.
discovered_via: SEG-02: LLM Inference & AI Infra Builders

recent_posts.text: By combining CRIU GPU checkpoint-restore with NVMe RDMA weight streaming, we cut 14B model autoscaling cold-start on Kubernetes from 92 seconds down to 3.8 seconds for our Jakarta fintech customers.
